title: cornus chinensis f. microcarpa
intro: Cornus chinensis f. microcarpa, commonly known as the Chinese Cornel or Dwarf Dogwood, is a plant species in the Cornaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cornus chinensis f. microcarpa include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic effects, which can help to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-viral properties.
